scope: All humanoid character assets in this workspace
camera_note: The camera and screen formulas below retain historical overhead defaults for v3. Since 2026-11-15 active art uses project_camera with the oblique profile above; topology and anatomical solver are unchanged.

coordinates.units: B = distance between shoulder joint centers

root.name: root
root.purpose: ground position; collider and export pivot; does not follow hat or sprite alpha bounds

invariants: One topology and solver; character differences are profiles, skins and action targets
Left and right anatomical bone lengths use the same profile fields
Bones never stretch to reach a wrist or foot target
Wrist, hand and equipped item share one consistent grip transform
One-handed actions do not force a mirrored support hand
Foot positions follow hip, knee, ankle and ground contact
Visibility is computed after the 3D pose; hidden anatomy is not moved to make it visible
The root remains the export pivot in all frames

pixel_art.wear: a few deliberate clusters; no noise, dithering or photo texture

base_locomotion_pose.name: ready
base_locomotion_pose.meaning: gameplay ready pose, separate from relaxed axe transport

axe_transport_pose.name: low_carry
axe_transport_pose.working_hand: closed around the wooden handle near the head, at the balance point of the specific axe
